text:
Eliot Chen: Heads up team 1 need a compact comm-kit for next week's benchmark webinar. Goal: quick spin for social, email, and a one-slide "flowmap" that sales can drop into decks. Deliverables: 1) Lottie animation (web landing) + GIF fallback, 2) email hero (800x300) + two mobile variants, 3) four social crops (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, story), 4) a simplified vector flowmap (600x360 export + SVG) showing webinar -> qualification -> demo -> trial, with routing labels for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Also need export tokens (sizes, filenames), alt text, and 2 copy hooks. Deadline: Fri noon PT.

Nia Gomez: Copy can do. I'll post two short hooks and 3 CTAs by tomorrow AM. Preferences? Tone: utility-forward, slightly playful ok.

Ravi Patel: For the Lottie: any motion constraints? Accessibility note: motion-safe version required (static PNG). Also confirm color overlay options for dark mode.

Eliot Chen: Motion-safe required. Keep motion < 6s loop, avoid strobing. Provide a static hero for reduced-motion. Dark-mode assets required. Use approved palette only.

Samira Ortiz: On the flowmap: sales wants explicit metrics on arrows (median latency, typical cost/unit). Can we include small stat callouts? They should be optional layers in the SVG.

Brand Review: Please use palette v3 tokens. Headline = Inter Display Bold, body = Inter Regular. No unapproved neon accents. Contrast: body copy >=4.5:1, large text >=3:1. Provide copy for alt text.

DesignOps Bot: Blocked a 2-hour design slot for Ravi Tue 10am PT. If you need faster turnaround, request override.

Ravi Patel: Will start comps tonight. Propose templates and a simple style frame then iterate. ETA first pass Wed 11am PT. I'll include layers for stat callouts and dark-mode variants.

Nia Gomez: Hooks dropping: "Benchmark inference: latency that scales, cost that doesn't" and "See the tradeoffs: speed vs spend." CTAs: "Register now" / "See the benchmark" / "Request a demo". Will add alt texts for each image.

Eliot Chen: Good. File naming convention: [asset]-[channel]-[size]-v1, e.g., hero-web-1600x400-v1.png. Add a JSON manifest with export sizes.

Samira Ortiz: Also request: a compressed SVG for email-safe inline and a high-res PDF for sales decks.

Ravi Patel: Noted. I'll export SVG, PNGs at 2x for retina, and a printable PDF. Will include Lottie JSON and GIF fallback.

Brand Review: We'll do a brand sweep within 24 hours of Figma link. Make sure to annotate color tokens.

DesignOps Bot: Reminder will fire Thu morning for final asset handoff checklist.

Eliot Chen: If anyone hits blockers on dark-mode contrast or motion accessibility, flag ASAP. Otherwise lock deadline Fri noon PT. Thanks! :partyparrot:
